continuity_scope: Divinity: Original Sin 2: Definitive Edition, Larian's 2017 Original Sin 2 release family, English product-page baseline. It is deliberately separate from Divinity: Original Sin Enhanced Edition, Divine Divinity, Beyond Divinity, Divinity II, Dragon Commander, and future Divinity works. This product-page pass records the Definitive Edition's visible origin/player framework only; no patch- or DLC-specific narrative state is imported.
work_or_witnesses: Larian: Divinity Original Sin 2 official game page
Larian Studios home page: Divinity Original Sin 2: Definitive Edition entry
coverage_rule: Zero-character evidence-constrained pass. Larian's selected first-party pages state that there are six unique Origin characters with distinct backgrounds and quests, but they do not provide a reproducible list of names or claim-specific individual character profiles/dialogue/codex locators. Custom player avatars are expressly variable. Rather than use forum discussion, wikis, or third-party profiles to fill the gap, the character and relationship arrays are empty.
omissions: All six named Origin characters because the selected Larian product page does not identify them or describe them individually at claim level; official cosplay file discovery alone is not an attribute witness.
Custom player avatars and all player-selected race, class, appearance, background, build, party, dialogue, relationship, and ending choices.
Factions, gods, Source powers, races, items, places, opponents, companions as a generic system, quests, mechanics, and rules as character nodes.
Earlier/later Divinity titles, Original Sin 2 patches, gift bags, DLC/merchandise/board-game expansions, mods, forum posts, community profiles, and adaptations.
uncertainties: The official page establishes the existence of six Origin characters but does not make an auditable individual-name/claim roster available in its text. This pass deliberately remains terms-only until direct Larian or in-game character evidence is supplied.
Origins may be selected as player roles and the product page stresses player choices and world reactivity. No fixed party, romance, fate, divinity outcome, or relationship graph is universalized.
The official product page is currently multilingual and identifies several localized language variants; English terminology is retained without merging variants.
Definitive Edition and the 2017 product page are an edition/release family boundary. Later updates, platform-specific behavior, and DLC/gift-bag content may diverge.
No plot-resolution claims are made, avoiding unmarked spoilers.
evidence_basis: First-party Larian official product pages only. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, community forum, walkthrough, review, or third-party character profile is used as canonical evidence.
